content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Consumer car marketplace selling listings and advertising to dealers; it does not run wholesale vehicle auctions or finance dealer inventory."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Online listings and dealer advertising business; no vehicle auctions, remarketing of fleet or lender vehicles, or floorplan lending."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Insurance claims and repair estimating software; it serves insurers and repairers, not vehicle remarketing or auction buyers and sellers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Pawn lending and used merchandise retail to individual consumers; no B2B auctions or dealer floorplan financing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Collector car insurance and memberships sold to enthusiasts; differs in customers, products and earning model from wholesale auctions."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Freight trucking and intermodal transport for shippers; moves goods rather than running vehicle auctions or remarketing."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Runs live and online auctions for used vehicles and equipment to dealers and fleet buyers, earning seller and buyer fees; closely matches OPENLANE."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Railcar manufacturing, leasing and highway guardrail products; asset manufacturing and leasing rather than vehicle auctions or remarketing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Automated traffic enforcement and toll processing for governments; no vehicle auctions, dealer customers or floorplan lending."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Fleet fuel cards and payment processing; a payments business that does not sell or auction vehicles."}]}
